notes: Circuit read from the wiring image: the upper half of the drawn breadboard (rows j-f) is mapped to catalogue bank 'b' (rows f-j), since the catalogue's 't' bank is rows a-e.

Green wire: MKR1000 pin 2 (D2) to column 3, row g. Resistor spans column 3 to column 6 on row h. LED anode (bent leg) is in column 6 and cathode (straight leg) in column 8, both on row i. Black wire runs from GND to column 8, row h.
Resulting current path: D2 -> resistor -> LED anode -> LED cathode -> GND, matching the schematic.
The tutorial's sketch drives LED_BUILTIN, but the text and diagram say the external LED is on pin 2. I followed the diagram.
The tutorial text calls the LED generic. Red is taken from the image.
No wire connects to A1. It is read in software only, as a floating input.
